Name: CustomersWithOrders
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: CustomersWithOrders, command: many)
SELECT id, name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id);
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1:name⟩\nFROM customers c\nWHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id);

Name: CustomersWithoutOrders
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: CustomersWithoutOrders, command: many)
SELECT id, name
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id);
